notes: Menus are a snapshot of published plans and may change.
Nutrition is per published serving_size. Portions are serving sizes, not quantities prepared or remaining.
Nutrition values retain source units and strings. Fields ending in _dv are published percent daily values. Empty nutrition fields are null; original empty strings remain in source_attributes.
All published data-* attributes are preserved verbatim (after HTML entity decoding) in source_attributes. No nutrients or serving sizes are inferred.
An empty allergen list means the source allergen field was empty; it is not an independent allergen-free certification.
Items repeated across stations or meal periods are intentionally retained.
Grab-and-go is a separate source meal period and is outside the four requested meal periods.
not_published indicates no source menu for that meal; it does not independently establish that the dining hall is closed.
